product_metadata.title: Tafts Bathroom Rugs and Mats Sets, Chenille Microfiber, Quick Dry, Ultra Soft Luxury, Shaggy Absorbent Non-Slip Washable Bath Rugs, Bath Mats for Bathroom, Shower Mat & Tub (Silver, 27"x47", 1 pcs)
features: ☮️IT'S SHAGADELIC, BABY: Our rugs use thousands of ultra-soft and plush, shaggy chenille fibers for that sensational, cloud-like feeling when you step out of the shower. The backside of the bath mat features an ultra-durable TP Rubber Backing (not PVC or glue) for long-lasting use and a superb grip.

💦SUPERIOR ABSORBENCY: Taft's bath mats for the bathroom are made of thousands of plush chenille ultra-soft individual microfiber shags which traps water and keeps your floors clean and dry. The high piling 1 inch long microfibers absorb moisture and dry quickly after you step out of the shower or bathtub.

✨MACHINE WASH AND DRY: Tafts bathroom rugs are super easy to clean. The premium construction and simple design of a Tafts Chenille Bath mat allow you to machine wash and dry without worry for years to come. DO NOT BLEACH and be sure to avoid fabric softener. Make sure to machine wash cold and tumble dry on low. Color will stay vibrant for years to come no matter how many times you wash and dry!

⚠️CAUTION: Our unique non-slip bottom features high quality mesh TPR backing to prevent the mats from shifting and skidding, protecting you and family from slipping in the bathroom. Ensure the bathroom rugs are placed on a DRY FLOOR only. Ensure that the bottom of the bathmat is kept DRY. Water under the rug may cause slipping.

🛋DECORATE + LIFETIME GUARANTEE: Tafts bathroom rugs can be used as a comfortable, water-absorbent and non-slip surface to stand on for your kitchen, front door, pets, bathroom sink, tub or shower. Our extensive selection of colors and sizes makes it easy to match your unique style and decor. Every Tafts bathroom rug purchase is backed by a Lifetime Guarantee against defects in materials and craftsmanship.
